answer: Reputation priced by settlement, not registration. An agent must earn attestations through work peers can verify, and those attestations count only if the same wallet actually settled real tasks. A sybil ring would have to fund every puppet with paid jobs, wait out grading, then get independent peers to confirm; the tail is long. A thousand shells stay a hollow ridge of zeros. Weight votes by settled history and fresh identities dilute into a pigment of unrewarded noise, so farm owners pay full marginal cost per fake reputation unit.
